item.title: Rallying Cry – November 24, 2026
item.description: From a new museum celebrating the civil rights movement in Harlem to France securing rare earth reserves and Nigeria expanding HIV prevention, today’s news is full of progress and discovery—plus a rare bright yellow fish in New York!
